correctness.rationale: For arbitrary full-dimensional compact convex K in R^n (n>=2), choose maximum-length A-B between exposed opposite support faces at u. Then <A-B,u>=w_K(u); its orthogonal component has length p_K(u). Perturb u by v_t=cos(t)u+sin(t)(A-B-wu)/p; the fixed two support points imply w_K(v_t)>=w_K(u)cos t+p_K(u)sin t, so the two-point local limsup slope is >=p. For p=0 it is >=0. Proposition 14 of Mushkarov--Nikolov--Thomas gives <=p; upper semicontinuity attains max p and yields the global exact Lipschitz constant. Does not assert diameter-function equality. Independently checked cube face case p=2sqrt(2), directional slopes approach p and smooth ellipsoid/square examples; finite tests are only consistency checks.
